mode: New asset generation with three existing GenTown icons supplied only as style references
notes: These are new sprites created for paultendo's overhaul. They are separate from R74n's original icons.
R74n's reference images remain unchanged in icons/. Their source and licence are recorded in vendor/gentown/upstream.json and vendor/gentown/LICENSE.txt.
Source artwork are preserved in source/. Each final sprite was exported at 32x32 using nearest-neighbour sampling and palette reduction without dithering.
The preview uses the existing VT323 font. Its authors and SIL Open Font License are recorded in vendor/gentown/fonts/VT323-LICENSE.txt.
Indexed colour regions, palettes and clipped overlays are embedded in the single-file mod. The original PNGs remain separately editable source exports.

assets.label: Clay
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production game inventory icon, an original sprite for paultendo's GenTown mod.
The three supplied images are STYLE REFERENCES ONLY: GenTown's 32 by 32 metal, stone, and crop icons. Do not edit or reproduce those icons. Create one new subject.
A single isolated sprite, truly pixel art conceived on an EXACT 32 by 32 logical pixel grid. Every feature is an integer cluster of those 32x32 pixels. Render as a perfectly sharp nearest-neighbour enlargement of that logical grid, square canvas, no antialiasing, no soft edges or gradients. Real transparent background (RGBA), not a painted checkerboard.
Match the references' modest chunky silhouettes, 1-pixel very dark brown outline, restrained earthy palette with 4 to 7 flat shades, one simple highlight on the upper left, simplified 1990s strategy-game resource sprite. Fill roughly 24 by 24 logical pixels with 4 logical pixels of transparent padding on all sides. Readable both on a dark game interface and in a tiny inventory. No text, frame, badge, glow, floor shadow, multiple objects or tiny decorative details. No smooth illustration masquerading as pixel art.
Subject: Clay as a raw commodity: one squat irregular lump of terracotta earth, with a rounded top and one thumb-sized notch. Warm ochre, muted salmon and burnt sienna planes. No vessel, no tile, no soil landscape.
